dataset.protocol: Author-disjoint; original tokenized annotation texts. Supplied-cast mode uses unambiguous proper-name aliases from human labels,never gold pronoun/speaker assignments or gender. Detected-cast mode uses only library-extracted names. Proper-name scoring is unique-surface,not nested/all-entity NER. Coreference scoring covers supported personal pronouns with exact original byte ranges. Quote scoring uses one-to-one normalized content multiset and separate speaker outcomes; legacy output has no locations. No data edits or model training.

limits: Independent published human labels,not blinded fresh editorial annotation or proof of all narrative semantics.
Unique proper-name and supported-person-pronoun tasks are narrower than full nested NER/CoNLL coreference.
Supplied cast is an oracle inventory;detected-cast mode measures its separate effect.
Normalized quotation-content multiset matching is not exact-boundary scoring and cannot prove source coordinates;source invariants have separate checks.
No trained model is used in the default baseline; confidence values are uncalibrated rule strengths.
